at market open price action was fuckin shite so waited for 3pm but i did have 662 market out which was the hourly fvg EL and RB, faded this level as it looked weak asf but ended up being a nice one, is what it is, moving onto the actual set up i took now. 

before i get into this breakdown i just wanna mention that this technically should of stopped my by .25 points but for whatever reason i didnt have a SL set. anyways, 

starting on the daily time frame we had just traded into the deep ote of the range, we usually get some sort of strONG reaction from here. usually i like another confluence on the dially but to give me full confidence but we didnt have that here. on the 4 hour we had a nice fvg with some EL sat inside of it, pretty sure we also had a 4 hr OB here to but i dont really tend to use these on HTF. on the hourly we had a similar fvg and a fvg lower, i did not use these tho.

it is important to note when stacking the confluences i talk about above it is clear that if we do get a bullish bounce then this is where it will be as no where else with as strong confluences allignment as this. also the ltf confluences i am about to speak about would nto be validated without these 

when i jumped onto the 15 min i could see that when we first tapped this area created a super tiny Rb with a nice distrubution/manipultion leg following its formation which didnt take any liquidity, however i wanted to use a 1 min ET in this instance for the most accuracy. also 15-1min tf allignment. 

after jumping onto the 1 min we pretty much had the exact same model but this time we had stacked RB

this is where things went slightly of tracks, i was in the barbers while trading and set my LMT at the RB high instead of the 1st gaps CE which was kinda dumb but is what it is, as well as this i forgot to place a SL which was a bad idea but we move, target was 10 am KO as it was first discounted thing that was actually a decent target.

messages.content_text:
Wed 4th Feb 


Coming into London open price rallied up after accumulation through Asia session. I suspected seeing an AMD play but wasn’t certain on it because NQ was still in discount of the general bearish range.
,


Price took Asia highs and the accumulation range high set in before it. I still wasn’t sure whether price would sell off from here especially because price was still rallying well.
,


When ES met 0.5 of the initial bearish selloff during NY yesterday, NQ was still within discount of this range. Drawing the fib on NQ’s current general range on the 15m I saw we were approaching 0.705 OTE lvl, I just couldn’t find a convincing Higher TF PD array to pair with this, but there was clear structure here and both pairs had reason to reverse from these fib lvl’s.
,


I waited for 3am volatility from here and I wanted to see price deliver back to midnight open, and take low resistance lows just under it, when I saw price sell off hard just after 3am I set a LMT at the IFVG for 3 micros with a 20 pnt SL above the high, with my 00:00 target for a 1:3RR
,


Price chopped for a bit at my entry but eventually delivered, getting my eval back into profit after being 1.2k down. Gonna start risking a standard amount now.
,


Id probs give this trade a B, it made sense looking at ranges with the Fib, paired with strong sell side DOL’s but because there was no PDA’s, just some choppy structure, and 3am displacement which could have just been a rebalance, it was a bit riskier in my opinion.
,

Still practicing these concepts and am not super confident with them so any feedback is welcome.

after this jumped over to the 1 hour to see we had a nice hourly fvg and RB which alligned nicely with the 4hr OB and still sat in that htf OTE, these 2 HTFs gave me everything i needed to. start looking for an entry around these areas 

when we first came up to the 1 hr fvg we gave a nice reaction and created a 1 min RB that was not valid due to the shitty distrubution candle that formed it so didnt end up taking it that time round, however we ended up distrubuting lower which validated the 1 min RB and formed a nice 5 min RB which was used as my ET

TRADE 1

coming into market open was leaning pretty bearish due to data low being such a clear DOL, we ended up tapping into a 5 min RB and swept asia highs ( they did not matter as it was just a random internal 1 min wick) and as well as this tapped into HTF OTE which usually gives us a nice rejection.

once we had this zoomed into the 1 min and 5 min, to which we formed a valid RB on both, both had nice distribution legs that took no major opposing liquidity, then saw that the 5 min rb eq 1 min rb and htf ote .705 all aligned so used that as my entry trigger with my stop above the highs targeting 1 min internal REQL which banged pretty nicely- took this trade on paper due to waiting for 10am so thats the reason i took another trade 


TRADE 2

after this my bias was no longer in place as i could see we were sat in a nice range and not going for data lows 

before looking for longs i made sure we were in ote- we where sat nicely in a 15 min ote, a few mid to htf RB and had a shit ton of stacked reql on ltf which usually like to give a rejection before being swept, we ended up sweeping a few of these lows which gave me confidence to enter upon the formation of a valid 1 min RB, we got this shortly after with a nice distribution leg that took no major oposing liq, after this i set my limit at the ce as it alligned closely with ce and a few other tf RB ce. 

my sl was below the RB low and my tp was at the 1 min rb which was created on the prev entry, i targeted this cause we were clearly in a ranging market, during the trade we did edge my tp at one point but my sl was trailed below the 1 min fvg so i stayed in and banged TP
